items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Buster is the guy, the only guy that Charlie Parker looked up to. I know a guy asked him, who is the best saxophone, Buster Smith...

ctx.x: We were playing around Massachusetts and New Lebanon, New York; that's where the Showboat was.
At that time, Lacey got this trouble and there was this thing called Charlie and Jerry.
